title: Vallee urges Hynek to review Blue Book's 'psychological' cases
place_text: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Dayton, Ohio

tellings.quote: jacqu valet had just met with Dr at rright patteron Air Force Base in Dayton Ohio in 1964

plain: In 1964 the researcher Jacques Vallée met J. Allen Hynek, a scientist who worked with Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, Ohio, and urged him to look again at the cases the Air Force had filed away as "psychological." The UFO investigator James Fox tells it, repeating what he learned of the meeting and pointing to the Blue Book files. He tells it because it would mean cases the Air Force had written off may have held more than they seemed.
